== Notes ==
* Even at 0 [[Expertise]], using this skill with a [[flatbow]] or [[shortbow]] will be as if you had +7.5 [[pip]]s of energy regeneration on top of your base energy regeneration if all [[attack]]s hit.
* Provides large potential energy returns with attacks that fire multiple arrows (such as [[Forked Arrow]], [[Dual Shot]], and [[Triple Shot]]).
* [[Asuran Scan]] can eliminate the chance of [[miss]]ing or being [[block]]ed.
